nodes.title: SG-4 · Remove admin ExecutionPanel UI
nodes.body:
Context: Worldseed must not contain development automation. The admin console in game/frontend still renders ExecutionPanel and calls /api/v1/admin/executions endpoints through game/frontend/src/api/client.ts. Desired behavior: ExecutionPanel.tsx and its tests are deleted, AdminApp and the API client no longer import, render or call anything execution-related. Expected result: remaining admin and game UI tests pass and tsc --noEmit passes. Why: the repo keeps only the game, contribution intake, round lifecycle and docs.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given the repo, when game/frontend/src/components/ExecutionPanel.tsx is looked up, then it does not exist and no test file imports it
- Given AdminApp is rendered with a valid token, when it loads, then it requests no URL under /api/v1/admin/executions and renders no execution panel
- Given the frontend, when npm run test and npm run typecheck run, then both pass


## Scope
- In scope: game/frontend/src/components/ExecutionPanel.tsx
- In scope: game/frontend/src/components/AdminApp.tsx
- In scope: game/frontend/src/api/client.ts execution functions and type
- In scope: frontend tests and fixtures for the above
- Out of scope: backend code
- Out of scope: LifecycleStepper behavior and deriveStage
- Out of scope: game UI components
- Preserve: Token gate, round create/open/close controls, world title, contributions list, 401 handling for round calls


## Technical constraints
- UI-only change in game/frontend; no backend or API change
- Frontend remains React + TypeScript + Vitest


## Definition of done
- ExecutionPanel and execution tests deleted
- AdminApp and client free of execution references
- Frontend tests and type-check green


## Clarifying questions
- None

- In scope: tests/actions.test.tsx

nodes.title: REQ · AdminApp no longer imports, renders or calls anything execution-related
nodes.body:
AdminApp.tsx imports ExecutionPanel and approve/retry/reject/listExecutions/findExecutionForRound and ExecutionInfo; it holds execution, actionError, actionDetail state, fetches executions in its load effect, defines runExecutionAction and renders ExecutionPanel. All of this is removed; the stepper uses the round status alone and the load effect fetches only the round and contributions.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given a valid token and an OPEN round, when AdminApp loads, then fetch is never called with /api/v1/admin/executions
- Given a CLOSED round, when AdminApp loads, then the stepper shows the CLOSED step as current
- Given a 401 from the round or contributions call, when AdminApp loads, then the token gate shows Invalid token
- Given AdminApp source, when searched, then it has no Execution, approve, retry or reject identifiers


## Scope
- In scope: game/frontend/src/components/AdminApp.tsx
- Out of scope: client.ts removal
- Out of scope: LifecycleStepper
- Preserve: Round controls, world title, duration and limit fields, contributions list, handleError 401 behavior


## Technical constraints
- Keep LifecycleStepper and deriveStage exports unchanged


## Definition of done
- AdminApp compiles without execution references
- Admin tests for kept behavior pass


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · API client and test fixtures carry no execution code and the frontend type-checks
nodes.body:
client.ts exports ExecutionInfo, approveExecution, retryExecution, rejectExecution, listExecutions, findExecutionForRound and getCurrentRoundExecution. These are removed. tests/executions.test.ts, tests/adminExecution.test.tsx and tests/adminActions.test.tsx exercise only them and are deleted; executionFixture and failedExecutionFixture are removed from tests/fixtures/api.ts; adminStepper, adminWorld and deriveStage tests are adjusted.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given client.ts, when imported, then it exports none of the execution functions or ExecutionInfo
- Given game/frontend, when npm run typecheck runs, then it exits 0
- Given game/frontend, when npm run test runs, then all remaining tests pass
- Given game/frontend/src, when searched case-insensitively for approveExecution, retryExecution, rejectExecution, listExecutions, ExecutionPanel, then there are no matches


## Scope
- In scope: game/frontend/src/api/client.ts
- In scope: tests/executions.test.ts
- In scope: tests/adminExecution.test.tsx
- In scope: tests/adminActions.test.tsx
- In scope: tests/fixtures/api.ts
- In scope: tests/adminStepper.test.tsx
- In scope: tests/adminWorld.test.tsx
- In scope: tests/deriveStage.test.ts
- Out of scope: backend
- Preserve: Round, world, contribution and player client functions


## Technical constraints
- Remove ExecutionInfo type only after AdminApp no longer uses it


## Dependencies
- req2


## Definition of done
- Client and fixtures clean
- Typecheck and tests green


## Clarifying questions
- None
